Guernsey County Auditor Tony Brown checks out the two dogs that received the first and second dog licenses of the 2018 year during a recent raffle to fund the Guernsey County Pound Partners. Debbie Chugg, left, has the number one tag for her dog, "Reis." The tag was a Christmas gift from her sister-in-law Nikki Salupo. Tina Bailey purchased the number two tag for her dog, "Gus." The Guernsey County Commissioners have extended the date to purchase dog tags without a penalty until Feb.9, 2018. Guernsey County Dog License Fees are $14 for one year license; $42.00 for three year license $140 for permanent license; $70.00 for kennel license. New this year online dog registration available online at guernseycountyauditor.org. Vendors participating in the sale of Guernsey County one year license include Orme Hardware in Cambridge, Moore Bros Hardware in Byesville, Guernsey Veterinary Clinic in Cambridge, the Guernsey County Dog Shelter and at the auditor's office.
